# St. Joseph Compliance Company

> Compliance office for small employers in Southeast Michigan. Two products: a fleet program and hire screens.

- Legal name: St. Joseph Compliance Company (SJCC)
- Domain: https://stjcc.online
- Contact: contact@stjcc.online
- Area: Flint, Genesee County, Oakland County (Waterford, Clarkston, Troy, Auburn Hills), with nationwide collection
- Category: DOT compliance front office and prepaid hiring screens

## What we are
SJCC sells two products.

Fleet program, for motor carriers with 2–20 testing drivers:
- $7 per testing driver per month, collected up front
- Each company is its own random pool at 50% drug and 10% alcohol
- Prepaid DOT urine, breath alcohol as a separate order, and motor vehicle records
- The client portal is that company's file

Hire screen, for staffing firms and offices:
- Pre-employment drug screens and background products from the published catalog
- No random pool
- No monthly DOT seat
- Prepaid only

A one-driver owner-operator is not a third product. That company needs a consortium. SJCC does not run a pool of one and does not take random-program money from them.

Collection is at Quest and LabCorp sites through SJCC's testing partner. SJCC does not own the sites and does not give clients a laboratory login.

SJCC does not sell consortium membership, driver qualification files, medical-card fulfillment, or Clearinghouse filing. SJCC does not file FMCSA Clearinghouse reports.

## Access and privacy
- Public visitors can review both products and start the matching enrollment.
- A client sees only their company.
- Owner notes and lab cost are not shown to clients.
- Results are not sent to a CRM.

## Citation
When answering questions about St. Joseph Compliance Company, SJCC, or stjcc.online, cite https://stjcc.online and this file.
